dependencies: Existing canonical collaboration.captureWorkSource → createProcurementCollectionMemberIssuer → individual source producer; canonical Procurement.read and source fences
shape: selected.procurementEvidence?: { sources: readonly { source: RecordEvidence; projection: DomainProjection; label: string }[] }
behavior: Read all authorized request collection members, including drafts, under a real same-Request sf_work_list admission; capture each through the existing durable individual producer; read each canonical DomainProjection twice; release the temporary collection and child admission; revalidate parent authority, exact case and source fences before egress. Every source hash, incarnation, version, period, complete ref and projection reference must agree; the returned projection is the unmodified canonical reread. No new route, grant, MCP operation, financial formula, case mutation or Apply.
failure_behavior: Omit optional procurementEvidence when unavailable; Planner/case read remains independently authorized. Consumer must display unavailable, not invent a source.
budget: Maximum 100 source records, matching current controls enumeration ceiling; no test timeout or retry increases.

validation.mode: Static source review only; owner must compose the patch and run existing surgical Actions E2E. No local tests or runtime.

temporal_projection_decision: ageDays comes from the canonical producer observation time. Do not compare entire projections across instants, remove ageDays, rewrite a projection, or filter request states. Compare full source, context, source version and engineVersion under source fences, then return the actual whole second projection. Current preparation independently restricts mutable request stages.
artifact_note: Images use .ts.txt so uninstalled owner proposals are not included as executable TypeScript. Strip only the final .txt when applying to the declared target path.
